[[File:Alex Tennet Worlds 2002.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Alex Tennet at the 2002 ''Lord of the Rings'' TCG World Championship.]]
'''Alex Tennet''' (Decktech handle '''Greedo''') is a United Kingdom Star Wars CCG player. He later played Decipher's [[The Lord of the Rings Trading Card Game]] and finished 2nd at its 2002 World Championship.

== Star Wars CCG ==

At [[DecipherCon 2000]] he was part of [[Team OK-UK]], whose shirts were made by Alan Rimmel. His Decktech report, ''deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cards'' (13 October 2000), covers eight games with Hunt Down and Hidden Base, including games against [[Dominic Gaudreault]] and [[John Arendt]]. It also records that [[Peter DiBiasio]] went undefeated and won Day 1 Swiss.<ref name="tennet">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-13-deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cardsd1338/ deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cards], Alex "Greedo" Tennet, Decktech (13 October 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008203411/https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-13-deciphercon-2000-juz-beer-and-cardsd1338/ Internet Archive]</ref>

His [[Dark]] deck '''Dark Surgeon''' (Agents of Black Sun) went 3-0 at the UK National in his hands, and won the Colorado state championship in the hands of [[John Arendt]].<ref name="dsurg">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/dschamp01_1.asp Dark Surgeon], Alex "Greedo007" Tennet, TheForce.Net. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250818094350/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/dschamp01_1.asp Internet Archive]</ref> GEMP's premade [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]] deck list includes it as '''P-RefII AOBS-Alex Tennet'''.<ref name="gempsample">[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/blob/master/src/db-scripts/sample_decks.sql sample_decks.sql], Players Committee GEMP source code (GitHub). Preserved copy: none yet (Wayback save failed 13 October 2026)</ref>
